- Contest repo (DELIVERABLE, edit here): `C:\openvela_ws\openvela\contest2026_416_dianzinongmingong\app\zhaoxi_ui\`
- UI source: `...\app\zhaoxi_ui\src\zhaoxi_ui.c` (346 lines)

- Makefile: `...\app\zhaoxi_ui\Makefile`
- Build tree copy (must stay in sync, but do NOT edit here): `C:\openvela_ws\openvela\apps\packages\zhaoxi_ui\`
- lv_font_conv entry: `C:\Users\27981\AppData\Roaming\npm\node_modules\lv_font_conv\lv_font_conv.js` (run via `node <that path>`)
- CJK font file: `C:\Windows\Fonts\simhei.ttf`
- FontAwesome woff: `C:\openvela_ws\openvela\apps\graphics\lvgl\lvgl\scripts\built_in_font\FontAwesome5-Solid+Brands+Regular.woff`

## Verified working command pattern (I already tested it)
```
node "C:\Users\27981\AppData\Roaming\npm\node_modules\lv_font_conv\lv_font_conv.js" --font C:\Windows\Fonts\simhei.ttf --range 0x20-0x7F --symbols "<CJK CHARS>" --font "C:\openvela_ws\openvela\apps\graphics\lvgl\lvgl\scripts\built_in_font\FontAwesome5-Solid+Brands+Regular.woff" -r "61451,61452,61459,61461,61561,61683,61931" --size 20 --bpp 4 --format lvgl -o <out.c> --lv-font-name zhaoxi_font_20 --no-compress
```
Notes: the `-r` list for the woff MUST be comma-separated in ONE quoted arg. `--no-compress` is proven to work. The `--lv-font-name` flag sets the exported symbol name deterministically.

## Required CJK character set (exact)
`夜深了注意休息早上好新的一天开始午工作顺利中记得下继续加油晚放松点你欢迎使用朝夕气提醒条待办首页对话设置月日周一二三四五六，`
(That includes the fullwidth comma U+FF0C at the end.)

## FontAwesome symbol codepoints used by the UI (must be in the font ranges)
- 61451 LV_SYMBOL_LIST, 61452 LV_SYMBOL_OK, 61459 LV_SYMBOL_SETTINGS, 61461 LV_SYMBOL_HOME, 61561 LV_SYMBOL_LOOP, 61683 LV_SYMBOL_BELL, 61931 LV_SYMBOL_WIFI

## Font sizes used in zhaoxi_ui.c
- 20: status bar (WIFI + " Connected"), agent status (OK + " AI Ready"), date, weather title (LOOP + " 天气"), task title (BELL + " 提醒"), nav button labels (首页/对话/设置)
- 22: greeting (Chinese)
- 24: nav button icons (FontAwesome)
- 28: weather value ("-- C") and task value ("0 条待办")
- 48: big clock "HH:MM" (ASCII ONLY — keep using `lv_font_montserrat_48`, do NOT generate a 48 font)

## Tasks
1. Generate FOUR font files into `...\app\zhaoxi_ui\src\`:
   - `zhaoxi_font_20.c` (--lv-font-name zhaoxi_font_20, --size 20)
   - `zhaoxi_font_22.c` (--lv-font-name zhaoxi_font_22, --size 22)
   - `zhaoxi_font_24.c` (--lv-font-name zhaoxi_font_24, --size 24)
   - `zhaoxi_font_28.c` (--lv-font-name zhaoxi_font_28, --size 28)
   Use the exact command pattern above. Verify each file exists, is non-empty (>50KB expected), and contains the exact line `const lv_font_t zhaoxi_font_<N> = {` (or `lv_font_t zhaoxi_font_<N> = {` — report which form the generator emits).
2. Edit `zhaoxi_ui.c`:
   - Add `LV_FONT_DECLARE(zhaoxi_font_20);` etc. after the includes (near the top, after `#include <lvgl/lvgl.h>`). LV_FONT_DECLARE handles extern declaration.
   - Replace every `&lv_font_montserrat_20` with `&zhaoxi_font_20`, every `&lv_font_montserrat_22` with `&zhaoxi_font_22`, every `&lv_font_montserrat_24` with `&zhaoxi_font_24`, every `&lv_font_montserrat_28` with `&zhaoxi_font_28`.
   - KEEP `&lv_font_montserrat_48` for the clock label (ASCII only).
   - Do NOT change any other logic.
3. Edit `CMakeLists.txt` so the font sources are compiled. Current content is a `nuttx_add_application(...)` with `SRCS src/zhaoxi_ui.c`. Change the SRCS list to:
   `SRCS src/zhaoxi_ui.c src/zhaoxi_font_20.c src/zhaoxi_font_22.c src/zhaoxi_font_24.c src/zhaoxi_font_28.c`
4. Edit `Makefile` to add `CSRCS = src/zhaoxi_font_20.c src/zhaoxi_font_22.c src/zhaoxi_font_24.c src/zhaoxi_font_28.c` (so the non-CMake build also works), keeping MAINSRC as is.
5. Create a reproducible generator script `C:\openvela_ws\openvela\contest2026_416_dianzinongmingong\tools\gen_cjk_fonts.ps1` that regenerates all four fonts with the exact same parameters (so the team can re-run it). Make it robust: derive paths, fail loudly if a font file is missing.
6. Sanity-verify glyph coverage yourself with a PowerShell check: read line 4 (the `Opts:` comment line) of each generated .c file with `[IO.File]::ReadAllLines($f, [Text.Encoding]::UTF8)[3]` and confirm EVERY char in the required CJK set appears in that line (the generator writes the char list into the Opts comment). Also confirm ASCII 0x20-0x7F is present via the `--range 0x20-0x7F` in the same line. Report any missing chars.

## Constraints
- DO NOT touch the build-tree copy at `apps\packages\zhaoxi_ui` (I will sync it myself).
- DO NOT edit README/docs/other repo files — another agent owns those.
- DO NOT add comments to zhaoxi_ui.c beyond the LV_FONT_DECLARE lines.
- Keep file encoding UTF-8 (no BOM preferred).

## Report back (concise)
- Exact list of files created/modified with byte sizes
- The generated symbol declaration form
- Glyph coverage check result (pass/fail + any missing chars)
- The exact SRCS/CSRCS lines you wrote
- Any command that failed and how you fixed it
